vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: pdf-to-csv
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is a straightforward API wrapper for the PDFAPIHub service (pdfapihub.com), designed to convert PDF documents into CSV format. It transparently documents that files are uploaded to an external cloud service for processing and requires a user-provided API key. No evidence of malicious intent, hidden data exfiltration, or prompt injection was found in SKILL.md or the configuration files.

llm.summary: The skill's functionality (upload PDFs to pdfapihub.com and return CSV) is coherent, but there are metadata inconsistencies and privacy implications you should understand before installing.

dimensions.detail: The name/description, SKILL.md, and example all consistently describe calling PDFAPIHub to convert PDFs to CSV using a CLIENT-API-KEY header. That capability matches the declared endpoint in skill.json. However, the registry metadata lists no required credentials or primaryEnv even though skill.json and SKILL.md require an API key — this mismatch is noteworthy.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md limits runtime actions to calling https://pdfapihub.com/api and accepting a URL/base64/multipart PDF. It explicitly states PDFs are uploaded to the vendor and warns about privacy; there are no instructions to read local files, other env vars, or system state beyond the provided PDF input.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only (no install spec, no code files executed). That minimizes installation risk — nothing is downloaded or written by an installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires an API key (CLIENT-API-KEY header) per SKILL.md and skill.json, but the registry metadata claims no required env vars or primary credential. This inconsistency could be benign (key provided at call time) but is unclear. Also, because user files are uploaded to a third-party service, sending confidential documents poses a direct privacy risk.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there are no config paths or persistent installs. The skill does not request elevated or permanent presence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill behaves as advertised (it uploads PDFs to pdfapihub.com and requires an API key). Before installing: (1) confirm how you will supply the CLIENT-API-KEY (UI prompt vs environment variable) because the registry metadata did not declare it; (2) do not send confidential or sensitive documents unless you trust pdfapihub.com and have verified their deletion/retention policy; (3) verify the vendor/domain (no homepage was provided in registry metadata) and prefer obtaining your API key from the official site; (4) prefer providing the API key through a secure secret field in the agent UI rather than pasting it into chat; and (5) if you need stronger assurance, ask the publisher for a homepage, privacy policy, and clarification about why credentials are not listed in the registry metadata.
